propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed to automatically monitor advisory criteria for promotion/demotion without outcome-corpus git-walks or LLM cost.
The recorder reads REVIEW_RESULT sidecars and appends firing rows (one per review-round, finding) to an append-only, prune-immune ledger keyed by (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id).

The --report subcommand computes per-criterion detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction de-escalated across re-review rounds without remediation) over a trailing window, auto-including all criterion ids seen.
The recorder is deterministic, incremental, and idempotent; it complements (not duplicates) R7's outcome-corpus metric by using sidecar re-review history alone as its signal source.
Committed artifacts (criterion_effectiveness.json, test suite) prove the recorder works over the existing ~37k-firing corpus with 40 criteria, 17+ with non-null detection/blocking-fp proxies.
